## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the cylindrical mug with handle from the table, rotate it, and set it in the center. Then hang the cylindrical mug with handle on the dark gray rack with flat back.

Task description: The object is the cylindrical handled cup on the left side of the table. Rotate it and set it down at the center of the table, then hang it by its handle on the angled bar of the rack on the right.

Success criteria: The cup handle must encircle the slanted rod, with the hanging contact horizontally near the middle between the post and rod tip and raised to rod height, leaving the cup hanging off the table. The right gripper must be open.

## Execution tips

- Consider grasping a cup-wall section near the mouth away from the handle, one finger inside and one outside. Adjust the opening for wall thickness and surrounding clearance and confirm the pads straddle the wall, leaving space to thread the handle onto the rod.
- When turning the cup, use an area with ample clearance around it and watch the sweep of the handle to reduce collisions with table clutter or the rack.
- As the cup handle approaches the rack bar, face the handle opening toward the bar's outer end and make small adjustments to tilt and position so the rod passes through while leaving clearance between the cup body and post.
- If a regrasp at the center is needed, first let the cup bottom settle before releasing the original grip. When hanging it, confirm the handle is supported by the bar before gradually releasing, to avoid the cup slipping once unsupported.
